finding.title: Fix FirestoreGatewayImpl.deleteUserData to target real nested Firestore paths instead of empty top-level ones

evidence.quote: // Step 1: delete Firestore data via gateway (client-side best-effort)

finding.why: deleteUserData(uid) queries users/{uid}/<name> directly for 10 of its 12 hardcoded names (completions, bookmarks, settings, streaks, profiles, goals, rewards, sync_queue, learning_order, stage_definitions) -- but per this same file's own doc comment two lines above the class declaration, all of that data actually lives two levels deeper at users/{uid}/learner_profiles/{profileId}/<collection>. The wrong-path queries return zero docs and delete nothing, silently -- an empty result looks identical to 'already deleted'. Two names are also stale ('streaks' vs the real 'streak_events'; 'profiles'/'rewards'/'sync_queue' match no real collection). account_lifecycle_service.deleteCloudAccount() calls this as 'Step 1' with a comment ('execution order is critical ... NEVER deletes local before cloud succeeds') that assumes this step does real, potentially-failing work; in practice it only removes the learner_profiles parent docs and diagnostic_logs, leaving every real child subcollection (completions, streak_events, learning_ledger, curriculum_tracks, goals, bookmarks, preferences/*, points_ledger, reward_redemptions...) orphaned in Firestore. Account deletion is not actually broken today only because Step 2 (deleteCurrentFirebaseUser) fires the onUserDeleted Cloud Function, which does a correct db.recursiveDelete of the whole users/{uid} tree -- making this entire client-side step dead weight that documents a guarantee it doesn't provide.
finding.recommendation: Either fix _deleteCollection's target paths to enumerate each profile under learner_profiles and delete its real, current subcollection names, or delete this client-side step entirely, rely solely on the onUserDeleted CF, and correct account_lifecycle_service.dart's comment so it stops claiming a partial-failure risk this step doesn't carry.
acceptance_criteria: Emulator test seeds users/{uid}/learner_profiles/{id}/completions (and siblings) and asserts deleteUserData(uid) actually removes them, or the step is deleted and the doc/comment updated to match.
No collection name in the deletion path diverges from the names used by this file's own push*/listen* methods.
